☀️ Your money this morning, Thursday 26 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: a quiet day. The Nasdaq slipped 0.6% and the S&P 500 0.3%, while the Dow rose 0.3%. US markets are closed today for Thanksgiving.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 1.6% lower on Wednesday.

🛢️ Brent oil is up 0.7% at about $95.26 this morning. The rand is steady at about R17.54 to the dollar, and gold is about $3,595.

What it means for you: oil back above $95 a barrel works against the December petrol cut.

📊 Today: Stats SA's producer inflation (PPI) for October.
